description:
Use Epi Info 7's NutStat module to assess the nutritional status of four children based on their age, sex, height, and weight. 

Goal: Create a report file at 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\nutstat_results.txt' containing the calculated Z-scores, percentiles, and nutritional classification for each child using the CDC 2000 growth reference.

Data:
1. Child A (Male, DOB: 06/15/2021, Date of Msmt: 06/15/2024, Height: 96.1 cm, Weight: 14.3 kg)
2. Child B (Female, DOB: 03/01/2022, Date of Msmt: 03/01/2024, Height: 80.0 cm, Weight: 10.5 kg)
3. Child C (Male, DOB: 09/10/2019, Date of Msmt: 09/10/2024, Height: 112.0 cm, Weight: 24.0 kg)
4. Child D (Female, DOB: 01/20/2020, Date of Msmt: 01/20/2024, Height: 100.0 cm, Weight: 12.5 kg)

Format the output file as follows for each child:
Child [ID]: [Sex], Age [Months] months
  Height-for-Age Z-score: [value] Percentile: [value]
  Weight-for-Age Z-score: [value] Percentile: [value]
  BMI-for-Age Z-score: [value] Percentile: [value]
  Status: [Classification]

Classifications:
- 'Stunted' if Height-for-Age Z < -2.0
- 'Underweight' if Weight-for-Age Z < -2.0
- 'Overweight' if BMI Percentile > 95
- 'At Risk of Overweight' if BMI Percentile > 85 and <= 95
- 'Normal' otherwise
